value: After the fighting, the quest brings Joseph’s spirit to Pamela, and the child speaks as if her father will come home. The account presents their reunion as the battle’s remembered resolution; the deeper effect of Chromie’s spell on a lasting timeline remains uncertain. Pamela then entrusts the traveler with a key to a chest behind the house. Her small act of welcome closes the chain with an image of homecoming, while the village’s original loss remains part of the record.
editorNote: Reunion and key follow secondary quest-chain transcription. The persistence and scope of temporal change require original-client and lore review.
